name: Blood Tithe

angles.text: Alvarion Windfield is a Skyborne farmer whose physical suffering and desperate call for aid highlight the struggles everyday Skyborne face beyond the settlement of Valanaar.

faq.answer: Alvarion Windfield is a Skyborne farmer who has come to Valanaar seeking capable fighters to help protect his home. Despite suffering from severe physical pain, he manages to direct adventurers to his wife, Aamelia, at their orchard.
Windfield Orchard is situated to the west of Valanaar, down in the lowlands. Alvarion sends adventurers there to meet his wife, Aamelia Windfield, who oversees the farm's immediate defense.
faq.q: Where is the Windfield Orchard located?

faq.answer: While the exact affliction is unstated when meeting him, Alvarion is visibly suffering from intense, debilitating pain as he speaks, adding urgency to his plea for help.
Aamelia Windfield is Alvarion's wife, stationed at the family orchard west of Valanaar. Alvarion directs willing adventurers to her to organize the defense of their land.

Blood Tithe begins with Alvarion Windfield recruiting travelers in Valanaar to assist his struggling farm. Adventurers must listen to his request and seek out his wife Aamelia at their lowland orchard.
faq.q: What is the task in Blood Tithe?

aliases: where does blood tithe take place
faq.answer: Valanaar is a settlement where travelers and Skyborne gather. Alvarion visits this hub specifically to find hired help and adventurers capable of rescuing his orchard from peril.

sections.body: In the settlement of Valanaar, an injured Skyborne man named Alvarion Windfield desperately searches for capable adventurers. Wracked with visible pain, Alvarion has traveled from his homestead into town to hire fighters who can help save his livelihood. Rather than tasking travelers on the spot, he implores those willing to help to journey westward into the lowlands, where his wife Aamelia maintains their family orchard.
sections.title: A Plea in Valanaar

sections.body: The Windfield Orchard lies situated in the lowlands to the west of Valanaar. With Alvarion incapacitated by intense suffering, the burden of holding the farm falls upon Aamelia Windfield. Adventurers taking up Alvarion's offer must make their way into the western valley to discover what threatens the orchard and lend their strength to the embattled family.
sections.title: Trouble in the Lowlands

summary: Blood Tithe is a quest initiated by Alvarion Windfield, an ailing Skyborne farmer seeking aid in the settlement of Valanaar. Desperate to protect his livelihood, he recruits adventurers to travel west to his lowland orchard and assist his wife, Aamelia.
